apptrequired.title: Appointment Required
apptrequired.remarks: Indicates if an appointment is required for the assignment.

wplaborid.title: WP Labor ID
wplaborid.remarks: ID to identify the EXACT WPLABOR record used to generate this row.

craft.title: Craft
craft.remarks: Code for the craft. Click Detail menu to choose an option to select a craft code.

dispstatusdate.title: Dispatching Status Date
dispstatusdate.remarks: Date the assignment dispatching status was last changed.

scheduledate.title: Scheduled Start
scheduledate.remarks: Scheduled start date and time for this assignment.

actualenddate.title: Actual End Date
actualenddate.remarks: Date that labor or crew completed to work on the assignment.

appointment.title: Schedule Lock
appointment.remarks: Indicates if the schedule is locked.

startdate.title: Start Date
startdate.remarks: The datetime someone was assigned to start this requirement

skilllevel.title: Skill Level
skilllevel.remarks: Skill level assigned to the craft.

splanreviewdate.title: Review safety plan
splanreviewdate.remarks: The date and time that the safety plan was reviewed

vendor.title: Vendor
vendor.remarks: Vendor associated with this assigned labor.

resourcelock.title: Resource Lock
resourcelock.remarks: Indicates if the resource is locked. Resource lock can only be set if a value exists in either the Labor or Crew field.

contractnum.title: Contract
contractnum.remarks: Contract number for an outside rate.

anywhererefid.title: Anywhere Ref ID
anywhererefid.remarks: Anywhere Reference ID for offline synchronization

workdate.title: Work Date
workdate.remarks: The day that labor availability was calculated for. This date can be different from the assignment dates if the shift crosses midnight.

finishdate.title: Scheduled Finish
finishdate.remarks: The datetime someone was assigned to finish this requirement

laborcode.title: Labor
laborcode.remarks: Code for the labor or craft that performs the operation. To edit this field, click Detail menu to choose an option to select a value.

wonum.title: Work Order
wonum.remarks: The work order number to which this requirement applies.

actualstartdate.title: Actual Start Date
actualstartdate.remarks: Date that labor or crew started to work on the assignment.

amcrew.title: Crew
amcrew.remarks: Identifies the crew that performed the work.

worklog.title: WORKLOG
worklog.remarks: Indicates if work log exists for the assignment.

parentassignid.title: Parent Assignment ID
parentassignid.remarks: The AssignmentID of the assignment this assignment was split off from.

qualmet.title: Qualification Met?
qualmet.remarks: Does this assignment meet the qualification requirements?

laborhrs.title: Hours
laborhrs.remarks: When an edit to the start date/time, regular hours, or overtime hours results in a total number of hours greater than the time span between the start date/time and the finish date/time, Maximo recalculates the finish date/time. You can edit this field until the work order is in the status specified on the Work Plan Edit Options page of Multisite.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: Current status of the labor assignment. Click Select Value and choose one of the following: ASSIGNED - To assign a laborer to the current work order. COMPLETE - To indicate the labor requirement is complete. WAITASGN - To indicate the labor is unassigned
